Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. Trashing revealed cards from your deck does not count as "trashed from your deck."
Card Q&A.q: When this card is trashed by a "Reveal the top X cards of your deck. [...] Trash the rest" effect, can I return it to my hand with this card's effect?

Effect: When this card is trashed from your deck, return it to your hand.
[Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 6 or lower Digimon. If there are 10 or more cards in your trash, add 1 to the maximum level of the Digimon you can delete with this effect.
